verdict.rationale: Reflect's docs say you can always export notes into an open format such as HTML or Markdown, and the founder repeats this in community discussion as the answer to lock-in concerns. Detail on the export itself is thin, and the API cannot serve note contents because they are end-to-end encrypted, so export is the only exit path. Missing for 10: JSON or other structured export, documentation of export structure (backlinks, tags, attachments, daily notes), local on-disk storage, and independent hands-on verification of export fidelity.
